name: Nabtesco Corporation
blurb: Nabtesco Corporation manufactures and sells industrial robot parts, construction machinery, railway vehicle brake systems, automatic doors, aircraft parts, automobile brakes and drive controls, marine, and platform safety products in Japan and internationally. The company is known for its precision reduction gears used in industrial robots, holding a strong market position in that segment. Founded in 2003, it employs approximately 8,472 people and operates in the industrial machinery sector.
recent: In the past 30 days, Nabtesco's stock price has risen significantly, reaching a 52-week high of 5,281 JPY. The company reported a strong earnings recovery with net income up 66.3% year-over-year, driving positive investor sentiment. Volume has been above average, indicating increased trading interest.
